description: Disk defragmenter: defragments files, folders, the MFT and other NTFS metafiles, and sorts files on the disk by path, size or date.
notes: This is the last open source release (7.1.4, 2020). UltraDefrag 8 and later are proprietary and paid, and are not packaged here.
Runs as administrator: Windows shows a UAC prompt on every start.
Start the GUI from the 'UltraDefrag' shortcut in Scoop Apps, not from a terminal: it looks for gui.ini, conf\options.lua
and logs in the current folder, and the shortcut starts it in its own folder.
The command-line tool is 'udefrag' (from an elevated terminal; see 'udefrag --help').
conf\options.lua is kept in $persist_dir and survives updates; gui.ini (window, sorting, language) is copied there on update.
The update check on start is set to 'Never check' on the first install, because newer versions are paid;
turn it back on in Help > Upgrade.
The portable build has no boot-time defragmentation and no Explorer context menu; both need the regular installer.
pre_install: # The GUI keeps its state in gui.ini through wxFileConfig, which saves through a temporary file and a rename,
# so a hardlink from 'persist' would break. It is copied in here and back out in pre_uninstall (which also runs on update).
# On the first install it is created with Help > Upgrade set to 'Never check' (Level=0; 1 = stable releases, 2 = all).
